verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST-based API v2, an Embed API with a JavaScript widget initializer, webhooks, and an official MCP server. Nothing in the pack mentions official SDKs or client libraries for any language. Raw REST endpoints and an embed snippet are adjacent building blocks, not SDKs, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
